notes.title: PMG #4
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/ae4b26c9c4f4ba5cf57acfc0f9f152afbddab469.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Today marks a milestone I've been working toward for months. The Off the Text demo is now live on Steam. If you're reading this, chances are you can already download and experience what I've been building. This feels surreal—seeing months of late nights and creative decisions finally in players' hands. Thank you to everyone who made this moment possible.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/e597f25340b75521b5532cd3eef4268824ba7bfc.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Demo is officially launched and available for download. The real work begins now: listening to your experiences and feedback. This isn't just about finding bugs or technical issues—I want to understand how the game feels, where it connects with players, and where it might fall short. Every piece of feedback becomes part of shaping the full release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/73374092ed17f6facdb45797823acbd0619d5f8e.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/6b8f558de434ed49edb0900b9ea847a759a4d65d.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/799c3bd99547535a710859f03830fd9bcf450551.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Viral Marketing Campaign Launch : I've been creating and uploading gameplay videos to showcase what Off the Text offers. These videos demonstrate the game's dark atmosphere and rhythmic gameplay mechanics.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/ff17b52dacb0c16c9e5ae4fcc21cb5adfa9394d0.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Steam Next Fest preparation is the immediate priority. This means press outreach and user support during the festival period. Beyond that, I want to deliver bold and experimental indie gaming experiences. The goal isn't just broader reach, but deeper connection. I want to deliver something genuinely special and unexpected in the indie space, something that could only exist through this collaborative approach between developer and community.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/fcdfd5df106a2e54b8f7c515fb10662903eb1ea8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/e58e71796138ac53ad823827fc66e8ca499f68da.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/cce37b99a60b14a39a3bf2c811d503d03dd3af24.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/b4c83b40b7552cc6b784a44948d39f43005f531a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/0ae490cd97bd69a39d4493f0d587af30c5cd7639.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]From concept to demo launch—I made it. The journey wasn't easy, but having your support made the difference. As seasons change (wherever you are), take care of yourselves. The conversation between creator and community starts now, and I'm excited to see where your feedback takes me next.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][b]　The Editor - "Your local community updates - let's build it together"[/b][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p]

notes.title: Pendulum Meadows Gazette
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/b9ac86f387ffcac44b9b73bc0e59a3ac9e996fa6.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Autumn is creeping in—at least for those of us in the north. Down south, spring's probably stirring instead. Either way, I've got news that matters regardless of your season. Steam review passed without any issues, and our demo launches September 23rd at 3:00 PM PDT. After all these months, I'm grateful to everyone who helped make this demo possible.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/9af7d6f7383d711c566ceef2eb397ae6dccfa6b7.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Demo approved and ready to go. September 23rd is locked in, and the three demo levels are polished for launch. What I'm looking forward to most is finally getting real player feedback—your experiences will directly shape where this game goes next.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/c0a32292ddd534cf7735b5a72167f9f7629b69c7.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/79651473dfa6193cdcdebf4dedbc0497ecc9b756.gif"][/img][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/ce2add7e57b37dd4c53dfb3bf1ae8174ffa49b57.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]This week I'm talking pricing structure instead of game mechanics. Originally planned a three-tier system to provide content that fits different price points, but I realized that the barriers and confusion this would create for players outweigh the benefits. I want to focus on delivering one complete, polished experience.[/p][p][b]　[/b]The full game now includes all 42 main levels plus upcoming seasonal content. No tiers, no confusion—just the complete experience. Take your time to consider, and visit anytime if it resonates with you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/38eef97b004fe6d6da35193f220e863b805af725.png"][/img][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/c18530dc5ea7c4f07493ea60747125379d866f56.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]Demo launch first, then listening to your feedback and turning it into improvements for the full release. Your voice becomes part of the creative process now.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/61bd910d045dae027249f7ae8653d86a5bb1e742.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/eb4607c7a851065f3120b3fab780d92ab03c0f10.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/63a57835aecc496873326582aaa0f48a9a8f5b4b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　[/b]September 23rd—the conversation between creator and community begins. Looking forward to seeing how you navigate these rhythms and what challenges emerge that I haven't anticipated yet.[/p][p][b]　[/b][/p][p][b]　The Editor - "Your local community updates - let's build it together"[/b][/p][p][b]　[/b][/p]

notes.title: Pendulum Meadows Gazette
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/b511e83300842287e0fb2536e701b3ff08b2df2b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]I owe you an apology, fellow readers. Issue No. 2 was supposed to hit your desks last Wednesday, but here I am a week behind schedule. Some unexpected complications threw a wrench in the timeline, but I hope you'll forgive the delay when you hear what I've brought to the table this time. Sometimes the best news is worth the wait.[/p][p]ㅤㅤㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/ebcc00a226d3cd731569c304c3defb6df04ac8e1.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]As promised in my last issue, the moment has finally arrived – Off the Text - Demo Track has officially been submitted for Steam review! The waiting game begins, and I'm looking at approximately 3-5 days for feedback from Valve's review team. Barring any unexpected roadblocks, the demo store page will go live shortly after approval, with the official demo launch scheduled for Wednesday, September 24th at 3:00 PM PDT. Mark your calendars, rhythm enthusiasts – this temporal journey will be available on both Windows and Mac platforms.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/13f42a3a01512886b5780744e9c44c48e309e004.gif"][/img]ㅤ [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/0816c223ed77d41fca31ed18459359980147c21c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]While I haven't rolled out any major new features this cycle, I've been fine-tuning the experience behind the scenes. Think of it as adjusting the tempo before the grand performance – subtle parameter tweaks that should make your interaction with the game feel more fluid and responsive. Additionally, I've squashed several minor bugs that were running silently in the background, ensuring a cleaner experience when you dive into those melodies from the timeline.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/655ef393b4662a953c51fa0f642f2675001c904c.gif"][/img]ㅤ ㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/13a22132729a1074ad2cae269ab58fbe5bad4cc5.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]My immediate focus remains razor-sharp: incorporating any feedback from Steam's review team to ensure a smooth launch. Beyond that, I'm diving deep into performance optimization, specifically targeting the core rhythm detection systems. Every tick of the clock matters when you're navigating the multiverse, and I'm committed to delivering the most responsive experience possible.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/e8d84c575a7dde791268c41c6a1fd6a0fbc1dca3.gif"][/img]ㅤ [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/93da1de671b5967234aa0d9df1a3a797790d1fd5.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/b0d6db65813c2971a099017401854a76ef73e5a4.png"][/img][/p][p]ㅤ [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/312fef1ba625ae920c9eb43db38b6f8ffe777a0f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]Your continued interest and patience mean the world to this solo developer working around the clock. If all goes according to plan, I'll reconnect for Issue No. 3 before the demo drops – and by then, I'll have concrete release details to share rather than estimates. Stay tuned to my timeline, and prepare for what's coming.[/p][p]ㅤ [/p][p][b]　 The Editor - "Your local community updates - let's build it together"[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Pendulum Meadows Gazette
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/9fbcfa49e3d60b1bc0ad868fdeab7996af4ae6cf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]Welcome to the very first [b]Pendulum Meadows[/b] [b]Gazette[/b]! Starting today, every two weeks, I'll be sharing behind-the-scenes looks into game development. If you're here, chances are you're looking for something fresh in gaming. These updates will cover progress milestones, design decisions, and the stories that don't make it into patch notes.[/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/db372a3975c19fdb385611ad3698719fa19c1bcd.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]Demo version final polishing is almost complete. I plan to submit the Steam demo for review this weekend at the earliest, or by next week at the latest.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/f300e5f80fde0e03ce860883b722eae85aef1f7b.gif"][/img]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][b]　 [/b]As mentioned on the store page, your feedback will help make this game even better. I've prepared three levels with beginner-friendly difficulty, and I'm looking forward to receiving your feedback once the demo is released.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/3563adeab352cf6011d18c3b324d2909dbe4beb6.gif"][/img]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][b]　 [/b]I try new ideas every day to deliver an enjoyable gaming experience. See you in the demo![/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/bd317f1656816f90e5ab1a87e7936ba8e374ae72.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 #1 Tutorial Audio & Level Creation[/b] : I've created dedicated tutorial levels to help new players easily adapt to the game. Players can learn game mechanics step by step with custom audio designed to support the learning process.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/d94ef7e8fee9c9a2941feaed53231b350703bb6f.gif"][/img]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][b]　 #2 Level Selection Screen Usability Improvements[/b] : I've made the level selection screen more intuitive. Visual and audio elements have been enhanced so players can quickly identify and choose levels.[/p][p][b]　 #3 Hidden Commands in Level Selection Screen[/b] : I've added the fun of discovering hidden features. Secret functions can now be activated through specific arrow key combinations on the level selection screen.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/f15ae106f878ce744a14d21050d35011cf36e89b.gif"][/img]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][b]　 #4 Individual Type Visual Effects Enhancement[/b] : Visual effects have been improved so that static elements now change dynamically based on the level environment. This provides a more immersive experience during gameplay.[/p][p]ㅤㅤ [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/c03264380f07e857b32feb8e35318cdf1a624d21.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]I'm preparing for the next phase of development for the demo release.[/p][list][*][p]Demo Version Issue Improvements and Fixes : I plan to quickly address any potential issues or usability problems that may be discovered through demo gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional Asset Creation and Implementation : I plan to create additional image and sound elements needed to enhance the game's completeness.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Partial Code Optimization : I plan to optimize the code of core systems to improve game performance. This is technical improvement work aimed at providing more stable and smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]　 [/b]Through these efforts, I will be able to present a more polished game in the full version.[/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/19f1e6c3f1860548e61da85b1db308ccead67831.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/165b4544a0031a809345756d929dfb964742ddca.png"][/img][/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674447/2253703946ccb82ea2daaa93061908ed29f8c65b.png"][/img][/p][p][b]　 [/b]Thank you for reading the very first [b]Pendulum Meadows[/b] [b]Gazette[/b]. I plan to continue bringing you development updates every two weeks. If you have any questions about the game development process or anything you're looking forward to, please feel free to share your thoughts anytime. Your voice is the driving force behind creating a better game. I'll be back next issue with more development stories.[/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p][p][b]　 The Editor [i]"Your local community updates - let's build it together"[/i][/b][/p][p]ㅤㅤ[/p]
